email_change.confirm_old.subject: Confirm you want to change your email address
email_change.confirm_old.body:
Someone asked to change the email address on your Avodeck account.

If that was you, open this link to agree:
{link}

If it was not you, ignore this email and nothing will change.
email_change.confirm_new.subject: Confirm your new email address
email_change.confirm_new.body:
This address was given as the new email address for an Avodeck account.

To confirm it, open this link:
{link}

If you did not expect this, ignore this email.
mfa.recovery_code_used.subject: A backup code was used on your account
mfa.recovery_code_used.body:
One of your backup codes was just used to sign in to Avodeck.

If that was you, there is nothing to do. If it was not, change your password and make new backup codes in Account.
notification.new.subject: You have a new message in Avodeck
notification.new.body: There is a new message waiting for you in Avodeck. Sign in to read it.
notification.digest.subject: Your messages in Avodeck
notification.digest.body: You have {count} new messages waiting in Avodeck. Sign in to read them.
deletion.certificate.subject: Certificate of deletion
invoice.sent.subject: Invoice {invoice_no}
spot_check.code.subject: Your code to open the pages
spot_check.code.body:
Your code is {code}.

Enter it when asked to open the pages you were sent.
org.invite.subject: You have been invited to join an organisation on Avodeck
org.invite.body:
You have been invited to join an organisation on Avodeck as: {role}.

To accept, open this link:
{link}

The invitation ends on {expires_on}.
case.reassigned.subject: A case has a new named expert
case.reassigned.body.outgoing:
You are no longer the named expert on a case in Avodeck.

Case reference: {case_ref}
support_access.granted.subject: Avodeck support can look at one of your cases
support.job_resumed.subject: Avodeck support set a paused job going again
support.job_requeued.subject: Avodeck support set a failed job going again
account.created.subject: Your Avodeck account is ready
account.created.body:
An Avodeck account has been made for you.

To choose your password, open this link:
{link}

The link works for {link_hours} hour. If it has run out, ask us for a new one.
